title: Points Earned on a Snowsports School Booking by a Household Staying with the Collective
content:
A household staying with the collective earns the stay reduction on its Snowsports School booking: a reduction in percentage points on the block price of the product booked. It is judged from the state of the household's Resort Lodging reservation and the deposit charged on that reservation's folio.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state and the deposit charged on that folio comes to a thousand dollars or more, the long stay points are earned, and they stand at 14 points. Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state and the deposit charged on that folio comes to less than a thousand dollars, the short stay points are earned, and they stand at 7 points. Where the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state, no stay points are earned, the reduction standing at 0 points.

## What is read

Two things are read from the household's Resort Lodging records: the state the reservation stands in, and the deposit charge entries standing on that reservation's folio, taken together as the deposit charged. A reservation standing in any state other than confirmed puts the household in the last band, whatever its folio shows.

## Reservation state, deposit and points

| Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state | Deposit charged on the folio | Points earned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 1000.00 USD or more | 14 |
| yes | exactly 1000.00 USD | 14 |
| yes | 999.00 USD | 7 |
| yes | nothing charged | 7 |
| no | any amount | 0 |

## An illustration on hypothetical folios

A household holding a confirmed Resort Lodging reservation whose folio carries deposit charges of 750.00 USD and 400.00 USD has 1150.00 USD charged in deposit, which is above a thousand dollars, so 14 points are earned. Had the folio carried a single deposit charge of 400.00 USD, the deposit charged would stand below a thousand dollars and 7 points would be earned. A household with no confirmed reservation earns 0 points on this count.
